# CombatSolver The Fool rules for the public beta

The Fool and Tarot rules for game v0.114.0 adapt code from Torch1230's CombatSolver v0.51.9 and refer to CombatSolver v1.0.3.

- [v0.51.9 arrow lifecycle](https://github.com/Torch1230/CombatSolver/blob/v0.51.9/src/Engine/InCombat/Simulation/CombatPredictionSimulator.Arrows.cs)
- [v0.51.9 shot card mirrors](https://github.com/Torch1230/CombatSolver/blob/v0.51.9/src/Engine/InCombat/Mirrors/Cards/OnPlay/FoolArrowCardMirrors.cs)
- [v0.51.9 arrow hooks](https://github.com/Torch1230/CombatSolver/blob/v0.51.9/src/Engine/InCombat/Mirrors/Hooks/ArrowMirrors.cs)
- [v0.51.9 Aim mirror](https://github.com/Torch1230/CombatSolver/blob/v0.51.9/src/Engine/InCombat/Mirrors/Hooks/Attack/AimPowerMirrors.cs)
- [v0.51.9 Fool card mirrors](https://github.com/Torch1230/CombatSolver/blob/v0.51.9/src/Engine/InCombat/Mirrors/Cards/OnPlay/FoolCardMirrors.cs)
- [v0.51.9 Tarot card mirrors](https://github.com/Torch1230/CombatSolver/blob/v0.51.9/src/Engine/InCombat/Mirrors/Cards/OnPlay/TarotCardMirrors.cs)
- [v0.51.9 Fool potion mirrors](https://github.com/Torch1230/CombatSolver/blob/v0.51.9/src/Engine/InCombat/Mirrors/Potions/OnUse/FoolPotionMirrors.cs)
- [v0.51.9 melody state](https://github.com/Torch1230/CombatSolver/blob/v0.51.9/src/Search/SimulatedCombatState.Melodies.cs)
- [v0.51.9 Show Off state](https://github.com/Torch1230/CombatSolver/blob/v0.51.9/src/Search/SimulatedCombatState.ShowOff.cs)
- [v1.0.3 behavior used for the v0.114.0 comparison](https://github.com/Torch1230/CombatSolver/blob/v1.0.3/src/HotKernel/Sim/Content/HotFoolTarot.cs)
